datasets.name: PubChem Compound & BioAssay Database
datasets.provider: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI / NIH)
datasets.purpose: Drug identification, chemical structure, 2D renderings, molecular weight, XLogP, TPSA, hydrogen bonding, and canonical SMILES.
datasets.usage: Provides foundational physicochemical descriptors to connect molecules across biological and clinical datasets.
datasets.caveats: Chemical descriptors represent isolated molecular properties and do not account for individual patient metabolic phenotypes without integrated modeling.

datasets.name: openFDA Human Prescription Drug Labels
datasets.purpose: Official regulatory warnings, boxed warnings, indications, contraindications, and mechanisms of action.
datasets.usage: Scientific and regulatory reference retrieval. Used to verify indications, warnings, and known risks.
datasets.caveats: Label text is qualitative regulatory documentation; it is not a direct quantitative prediction of individualized response probability.

datasets.name: FDA Drug-Induced Liver Injury Rank (DILIrank 2.0)
datasets.provider: FDA National Center for Toxicological Research (NCTR / LTKB)
datasets.purpose: Standard benchmark for drug-induced liver injury classification (v-Most-DILI-concern, v-Less-DILI-concern, v-No-DILI-concern).
datasets.usage: Primary supervised machine learning dataset for hepatic liability classification with SHAP feature explainability.
datasets.caveats: Classification indicates aggregate pharmacological/regulatory hepatotoxicity concern, not an individual patient's absolute diagnostic risk.

datasets.name: LINCS L1000 Gene Expression Perturbation Compendium
datasets.provider: NIH Library of Integrated Network-Based Cellular Signatures (LINCS)
datasets.purpose: Experimental transcriptional changes (Z-scores) in response to chemical perturbagens across varied cell lines, doses, and exposure times.
datasets.record_count: Benchmark subset of 978 landmark genes across key cell lines (HEPG2, A549, MCF7, PC3)
datasets.usage: Predicting multi-target gene modulation, cellular stress, DNA damage, and apoptotic biological pathway responses.
datasets.caveats: Cell-line in-vitro assays reflect cellular transcriptional responses and cannot be equated to direct whole-human physiological organ function.

datasets.name: ClinPGx / PharmGKB Pharmacogenomic Knowledgebase
datasets.purpose: Evidence-based gene-drug interactions, CYP450 metabolizer phenotypes (PM, IM, NM, UM), and therapeutic dosage guidance.
datasets.usage: Pharmacogenomic rule engine providing variant-specific metabolic liability and personalized clinical recommendations.
datasets.caveats: Pharmacogenomic annotations represent clinical consensus guidelines; actual patient drug levels depend on organ clearance and drug interactions.

datasets.name: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS)
datasets.purpose: Post-marketing safety surveillance, adverse reaction frequency distributions, and disproportionality metrics (PRR, ROR).
datasets.usage: Real-world adverse event signal detection and reporting trend exploration.
datasets.caveats: FAERS is a spontaneous voluntary reporting database subject to under-reporting, notoriety bias, and confounding. Report frequency does NOT establish causal risk.

datasets.name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database (Optional / Credentialed Module)
datasets.provider: MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology / Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
datasets.purpose: De-identified real-world clinical records, lab measurements, medication administrations, and hospital outcomes.
datasets.caveats: Requires PhysioNet credentialing, CITI human subjects training, and Data Use Agreements. The platform functions autonomously without MIMIC-IV dependence.
